config.note: Communication-bound decode latency. Per token, every MoE layer runs an all-to-all that dispatches the token's hidden vector to its top-k experts (FP8, 1 byte) and combines the results back (BF16, 2 bytes). DeepSeek's hardware report computes a ~14.76 ms TPOT ceiling (~67 tok/s per request) from this shuffle alone on a 400 Gbps InfiniBand fabric (~50 GB/s effective). The curve scales that published anchor by each model's relative all-to-all volume (3 x top-k x hidden x MoE-layers) and inversely with effective interconnect bandwidth; compute and dual-microbatch overlap are idealized away, so this is the network's best case.
